_: Hoop family stations, real millimetres unless the key says units. Hand-authored; scripts/build-hoop-family-svgs.mjs reads it, the 3D builders mirror it, and tests pin the mirrors. Every number names its source.

tube_od_mm.source: 5/8in HDPE hoop tubing, the only size that holds an 18.5in ring (hoop-geometry.ts)

big_scale.source: Prop3D.svelte BIG_SCALE, the factor every big variant uses

hoop_join_tape_mm.source: gaffer band over the insert connector, measured on a hoop in hand

hoop_button_mm.source: push button showing through the join tape

hoop_button_glyph_units.source: floor for the button radius at the mini scale; the real 6 mm button rounds to 0.8 units and would vanish

hoop_grip_tape_mm.source: grip wrap opposite the join, measured on a hoop in hand

hardware_ratio.source: printed elbow sleeve OD over tube OD in the triangle photo; tape bands use the same ratio

triangle_side_mm.source: 22in; the photo's tube-to-side ratio of 0.028 at a 5/8in tube

triangle_sagitta_mm.source: 4% of the chord, the outward bow of each side in the photo

elbow_leg_mm.source: how far the printed elbow reaches along each side, photo

glyph_tube_units.source: notation weight, about 2x the real tube at the mini glyph's scale (the old drawing used 16)

big_glyph_tube_units.source: the largest weight that keeps the big ring inside its 600x300 box

mini_glyph.source: the shipped minihoop box and the centreline its tip points measure

big_glyph.source: the shipped bighoop box and the centreline its tip points measure

grip_band_hex.source: the gold the triad and quiad glyphs already use for their grip

hardware_hex.source: matte black printed PLA and gaffer tape; dark enough for selective recolor to preserve

button_hex.source: the push button, a shade lighter than the tape so it reads on top of it

tube_hex.source: neutral gray placeholder that selective recolor repaints in the hand colour
